overview: Complete UI/UX transformation of India's leading competitive exam preparation platform — spanning test series, live classes, performance analytics, community features, and cross-platform expansion.

subprojects.title: Test Series
subprojects.description: A comprehensive upgrade designed to revolutionize the online test-taking experience for students preparing for competitive exams. Created a more engaging, informative, and user-friendly environment that closely simulates real exam conditions while providing valuable insights for improvement.

subprojects.title: Live Class
subprojects.description: Transitioned from third-party live streaming to an in-house Live Class module. Designed a comprehensive live class experience with real-time interaction, content sharing, performance measurement, and efficient learning features.

subprojects.title: iOS & iPad App
subprojects.description: Expanded Adda247's reach to Apple users by designing a native iOS and iPad application, followed by an optimized Android version.

subprojects.title: Sankalp Bharat App
subprojects.description: Transformed the home screen of the Sankalp Bharat app (targeting IIT/JEE aspirants) from a low-engagement feed into a value-driven hub showcasing features and benefits to drive user engagement and conversion.

subprojects.title: Studio App for Smart Boards
subprojects.description: An in-house application enhancing the teaching experience by addressing challenges educators face with whiteboard-based explanations. Provides tools for efficient management and sharing of recorded content.

subprojects.title: My Content
subprojects.description: Shifted from a package-centric to user-centric content consumption model. Enhanced content discoverability, improved engagement, and optimized the learning experience with clear progress tracking and strength/weakness identification.

subprojects.title: Community
subprojects.description: Built a collaborative community module transforming Adda247 beyond content delivery — enabling peer-to-peer learning, doubt resolution, content sharing, and engagement among students.

subprojects.title: Performance Dashboard
subprojects.description: Designed comprehensive analytics dashboard providing actionable insights into learning journeys — covering test performance, content consumption, and personalized improvement paths.

overview: Designed premium digital experiences for Dubai's most exclusive luxury real estate properties under the Omniyat brand — including LIV, Orla Infinity, ELA, OPUS, Vela Viento, and more.

subprojects.title: LIV
subprojects.description: Positioned LIV as the exclusive partner for Omniyat's luxury properties. Created a premium platform through deep user research, sophisticated design aesthetic, and personalized customer service. Resulted in increased brand recognition and successful property sales.

subprojects.title: Orla Infinity
subprojects.description: An architectural masterpiece on Palm Jumeirah. Designed the digital presence for this Omniyat project offering unparalleled luxury living with breathtaking views, bespoke interiors, and world-class amenities.

subprojects.title: ELA Residences
subprojects.description: Designed the digital experience for Ela Residences — a unique blend of wellness and luxury on Palm Jumeirah by Foster + Partners, featuring eco-conscious design and smart home technology.

subprojects.title: OPUS
subprojects.description: Created the digital presence for OPUS — a landmark Dubai building designed by Zaha Hadid, featuring luxury residences, offices, and a hotel.

subprojects.title: Vela Viento
subprojects.description: Designed the luxury web experience for Vela Viento — a Foster + Partners development in Marasi Bay with high-end apartments, stunning waterfront views, and Dorchester Collection services.

subprojects.title: Anwa Aria
subprojects.description: Crafted the digital experience for Anwa Aria — a luxury residential tower in Dubai Maritime City, emphasizing waterfront living and modern design.

subprojects.title: LIV Reside
subprojects.description: Designed the online platform for LIV Reside — an upscale residential project offering luxurious apartments with high-end amenities and a focus on community living.

results.label: Increase in qualified leads for LIV

overview: Designed the complete product suite for Kelp Global — a customer relationship platform including browser plugins, analytics dashboards, and deal management modules.

subprojects.title: Kelp Plugin
subprojects.description: Designed an intuitive browser plugin for real-time customer intelligence — surfacing relevant insights directly within the user's workflow without context-switching.

subprojects.title: Truenorth
subprojects.description: Built the analytics and reporting interface for Kelp's Truenorth module — providing sales teams with clear performance metrics and actionable pipeline insights.

subprojects.title: Deals Module
subprojects.description: Designed the deal pipeline management interface — enabling sales teams to track, manage, and close deals efficiently with clear visual workflows and status tracking.

overview: Designed Portle — a developer-first API management platform with a clean, minimalist interface that reduces cognitive load while supporting diverse branding requirements across companies.

subprojects.title: Portle
subprojects.description: Created a clean and minimalist API management interface for developers. Focused on reducing cognitive load in complex environments through careful information hierarchy, visual design, and flexible branding support.

overview: Designed next-generation automotive HMI experiences for Tata Elxsi — including infotainment systems and digital instrument clusters for connected vehicles.

subprojects.title: Infotainment System
subprojects.description: Designed the next-generation in-vehicle infotainment interface — balancing driver safety with intuitive media, navigation, and vehicle controls through a distraction-minimized touchscreen experience.

subprojects.title: Instrument Cluster
subprojects.description: Created a digital cockpit instrument cluster design — presenting critical driving information through clear visual hierarchy, real-time data visualization, and adaptive display modes.
